0022600005.text: Both teams open their 2026-27 seasons when the Warriors visit the Lakers, and Golden State will be without Jimmy Butler III (knee surgery), Kristaps Porzingis (undisclosed reason), and Moses Moody (knee surgery). In the 2025-26 season series, the Warriors lost 1-3, including a 119-103 defeat in San Francisco on April 9, 2026. ESPN's matchup predictor gives the Warriors a 35% chance to win.
